title: From Numerical Simulators of PDEs to Neural Emulators and Back
abstract: arXiv:2608.24547v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Simulation is central to modern engineering and science, but the cost of numerical solvers for partial differential equations (PDEs) remains a bottleneck whenever fast or many-query evaluations are required. Neural emulators trained on solver-generated data promise significant speedups, yet they are usually framed as opaque alternatives to the very methods that produce their training signal. This thesis argues the two paradigms are more alike than different: neural architectures mirror classical discretizations, their errors are amenable to the same spectral analysis, and insight flows profitably in both directions. We approach the relationship by disentangling the multiple roles a solver plays in the emulator learning pipeline. Mode-wise Fourier analysis then provides a common language in which solver errors, architectural inductive biases, and training objectives can all be read off simultaneously. translated_title: 从偏微分方程数值模拟器到神经仿真器再回归
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24547v1 公告类型：新 摘要：模拟是现代工程和科学的核心，但当需要快速或多次查询评估时，偏微分方程（PDE）数值求解器的成本仍然是一个瓶颈。基于求解器生成数据训练的神经仿真器承诺显著加速，但它们通常被视为产生其训练信号的原始方法的黑箱替代品。本论文论证这两种范式相似多于不同：神经架构镜像了经典离散化方法，其误差适用于相同的谱分析，且洞察在两者之间双向流动。我们通过解开求解器在仿真器学习流程中扮演的多种角色来探讨这种关系。模式傅里叶分析随后提供了一种共同语言，使求解器误差、架构归纳偏差和训练目标能够同时被解读。综合起来，这允许合成新的方法。
tldr: 本论文论证了PDE数值求解器与神经仿真器在架构和误差分析上本质相似，并通过模式傅里叶分析统一理解它们，实现双向洞察和新型方法合成。
en_tdlr: This thesis argues that PDE numerical solvers and neural emulators are fundamentally similar in architecture and error analysis, using mode-wise Fourier analysis to unify their understanding, enabling bidirectional insights and synthesis of novel methods.
